description: Minimal smoke tests: skill triggers on full-OSS-prep phrasing and walks through the 6-step orchestration without crashing.

cases.prompt: Walk this project through the full OSS release workflow end-to-end so it's ready to make public.
expected_behavior: Skill 'oss-ready-flow' is invoked (not 'oss-ready' alone, not 'docs-generator' alone).
Step 0 setup runs: confirms working directory, runs Repo Sync, asks for license + SECURITY contact email.
Step 1 spawns a read-only Auditor sub-agent and emits a Step Completion Report.
Main agent waits for user 'yes / skip / stop' before dispatching step 2.

cases.prompt: I want to clean up branches as part of getting this repo open-source ready. Use the OSS flow.
expected_behavior: Skill recognises this is an OSS-flow request, starts at step 1 (audit), and continues to step 2 (branches).
Step 2 produces a per-branch plan and asks for per-branch approval; never deletes silently.

cases.prompt: Run an OSS readiness audit on this repo.
expected_behavior: Skill 'oss-ready-flow' does NOT trigger (audit-only is the 'oss-ready' skill's territory).

cases.prompt: Rewrite my README to be cleaner.
expected_behavior: A doc-focused or README-focused skill (docs-generator or similar) triggers, or the agent edits directly without a skill.
